summary: Comprehensive testing of GGS (Game Gear Swap) marketplace after major refactor from paid-to-post to FREE-to-post model. All 28 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend testing shows all core features working correctly including homepage, auth, marketplace filters, post listing (4 steps), product detail, and dashboard.

frontend: Homepage loads with hero section, categories, search bar
FREE CTA button displayed ('Post Your Ad - It's Free!')
Marketplace filters (category, condition, location, price, sort)
Signup page with all form elements
Post Listing page shows 4 steps (not 5 - payment removed)
Dashboard with Listings, Wishlist, Payments, Profile tabs
Product detail page with title, price, wishlist button, seller info

critical_code_review_comments: FREE-to-post model correctly implemented - listings set to 'active' and 'payment_status: completed' immediately
PostListing.js has unused variables (paymentLoading, paymentId, showPaymentModal, handlePayment) from old payment flow - can be cleaned up
Google Auth and Mobile OTP are MOCKED on frontend only - not production-ready
seed_data_creation: Database seeded with admin user, test user, 6 categories with subcategories, and sample listings
